title: $150,000 in 8 months. That’s how much a simple indie game can make - even if you’re solo, coding at night, fueled only by coffee and stubbornness.
author: Resident-Aspect4084
selftext:
https://youtu.be/GlJosCyFDJI


This year, I decided to try something similar.
I’m releasing Hill Dash Race 🚗⛰️ today - a 1-week solo project to see if it can reach players organically.

Being a solo dev in side project is brutal and lonely:
No one to bounce ideas off.
No one to share the load when burnout hits.
Grants? Most see you as “high risk.”

But I keep going.
This game isn’t just a project - it’s proof that passion + persistence = chance at success.

If you want to support a solo dev:
 ⭐ Share this game
 ⭐ Download
 ⭐ Leave a rating
 ⭐ Drop a quick review

Every small action matters.
Now I’m curious -
What are you building? Share it below! 
My link to this game is there
